config.mean_field: propensity at the midpoint of each band; each payer capped in the share of rounds from open_from with the control's holding below its share of the bill; the control's closing membership; issuance response zero
config.path_tangent: the control's own propensity draws, payer caps, membership and issuance, round by round; the issuance response on for A44-1 and off for I1 and I3

criteria.detail: Holds on all 50 cells: with 1e-07 claims added a round to the whole model, each of the four classes' shares of the end-of-run gain from the model and from the tangent differ by at most 1e-05.
criteria.name: A44-1  the path tangent is the carrier's rule: its split matches a finite difference of the whole model on every cell

criteria.detail: Holds on all 65 carriers, 15 of them the default and 50 variants of it: on the block of trading nodes and the spending state every column moves its claims without loss to within 1e-12; exactly one eigenvalue lies within 1e-09 of 1; for each target the sum of 250 rounds equals the horizon times the stationary vector plus the deviation matrix's term less its tail, to 1e-10 relative.
criteria.name: A44-2  the mean-field map conserves claims, has one stationary split, and its deviation matrix closes the finite sum
